headline: Ripley Posts Q3 Profit Jump Supported by Banking and Peru Operations
summary: Ripley reported a 53% increase in third-quarter profits, supported by its banking business and operations in Peru, despite lower retail sales in Chile.
why: Ripley is a major South American department store and financial services operator exposed to retail consumption trends across Chile and Peru.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Strong financial results in banking and Peruvian operations boosted quarterly profits.
